First, we compare the proposals in the DA algorithm to a balls-in-bins process. This comparison itself is not new: analyzing the DA as a balls-and-bins or coupon-collector game dates back to the original papers by [28, 17]. We add to this approach by providing some general bounds using simple methods that could simplify similar proofs in the future.
